% ---------- 交互序列 ----------

% 1. Agent发起系统调用
\draw[dataflow] (0,-1) -- (2.5,-1)

\draw[dataflow, ->] (5,-6.0) -- (ml);
\node[font=\sffamily\tiny, fill=iconorange!5, inner sep=2pt] at (5.8,-6.3) {6. ML深度分析};

% 6. 异常确认 → 告警
\draw[dataflow, draw=iconorange] (5,-7.0) -- (7.5,-7.0)
  node[midway, above, font=\sffamily\tiny\color{iconorange}] {7. 异常确认};

% 7. 告警通知
\draw[dataflow, draw=iconorange] (7.5,-7.5) -- (0,-7.5)
